json.expanded_prompt:
I notice the two attachments don't match the described action: Image 1 is a close-up of hands holding an already-open red lipstick, and Image 2 is a four-panel full-body fashion reference of a blonde woman in a black turtleneck. I'll build the prompt so the lipstick action (Image 1 context) drives the moving video while Image 2 serves as a style/appearance reference.

subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the keyframe reference: a hands-only close-up of a woman with light-medium skin and light-colored manicured nails, wearing a black long-sleeve ribbed turtleneck, holding a black lipstick tube with a silver/liquid-metal band and a bright red bullet against a white subway-tile wall, a black granite sink, a chrome faucet, and warm window light; the shot opens the video exactly at this frame.
<Picture 2> is the subject-and-style reference: a blonde woman with long wavy hair, wearing a black ribbed turtleneck and dark sunglasses, shot in a clean four-panel lookbook style on a soft pink background; she provides the person, wardrobe (black turtleneck), and bright, polished, minimal aesthetic for the target video.
<Subject 1> is the blonde woman from <Picture 2>, the holder of the lipstick, shown from above the shoulders in a clean indoor setting matching the bright minimalist tone of <Picture 2>.
<Subject 2> is the red lipstick with a black glossy tube and chrome band taken from <Picture 1>, the central product being manipulated.

summary:
[keyframe completion] The target video opens on the close-up frame from <Picture 1> and continues as <Subject 1>'s hands twist the <Subject 2> lipstick bullet upward and rotate it in the warm window sunlight, while the camera performs a slow, gradual push-in toward the product for the full 6 seconds.

detailed_description:
The video is a polished 6-second product beauty close-up in a bright, clean, natural-light aesthetic consistent with the minimal lookbook tone of <Picture 2>. The first frame is exactly <Picture 1>.

[Shot 1] A tight hands-only close-up matching <Picture 1>: <Subject 1>'s two hands with a black ribbed turtleneck sleeve hold <Subject 2>, a black glossy lipstick tube with a chrome band and a vivid red bullet, against a backsplash of white subway tiles, a black granite sink, a brushed-chrome faucet, and a black soap dispenser, with a diagonal warm sunbeam falling across the tiles. The camera holds a mostly Static Shot on the product. <Subject 1>'s index finger presses and the base gives, then the base rotates and the red bullet of <Subject 2> twists slowly upward out of the chrome rim. As the bullet rises, <Subject 1> tilts the tube toward the window so the polished red tip catches the warm sunlight and flashes a soft highlight. The camera performs a gradual Push In with small amplitude at slow speed, drawing the red bullet and the chrome band into an increasingly tight center composition. The natural window light stays warm and directional, glinting off the metal and the sheen of the lipstick.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot continues without a hard cut, the Push In easing to a gentle hold and settling the fully extended <Subject 2> centered in sharp focus on <Subject 1>'s manicured hand against the softly blurred tile background, the sun glinting steadily across the red bullet as the 6-second close-up resolves.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, intimate bathroom ambience in natural daylight, carrying a soft, precise "click" of the tube base engaging, a fine mechanical twist of metal, and the gentle contact sound of the lipstick base rotating in the hand, with faint room silence underneath throughout the 6 seconds.
